name: ovr_locked_faith_listint
command: mkdir -p logs/ov_reader && PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python -m scripts.evaluation.eval_ov_reader --mode faithfulness --datatypes "list[int]" |& tee logs/ov_reader/locked_faith_listint.log

name: cv2_ovr_locked_caus_listint
command: mkdir -p logs/causal_v2 && PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python scripts/evaluation/run_causal_v2.py scripts.evaluation.eval_ov_reader --mode causality --datatypes "list[int]" |& tee logs/causal_v2/locked_caus_listint.log
